description: This file implements the OCIContainer class, which manages the lifecycle and registration of an OCI container plugin within the WPEFramework. It includes initialization, deinitialization, and notification handling for the container service.

classes.name: WPEFramework::Plugin::OCIContainer
classes.description: Represents the OCI container plugin, handling its lifecycle, registration, and notifications within the WPEFramework.

methods.name: OCIContainer::OCIContainer
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the OCIContainer instance and sets it as the singleton instance.

methods.name: OCIContainer::~OCIContainer
methods.description: Destructor that cleans up the OCIContainer instance and resets the singleton.

methods.name: OCIContainer::Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the OCIContainer with the provided service, sets up notifications, and registers the container implementation.

methods.name: OCIContainer::Deinitialize
methods.description: Cleans up resources, unregisters notifications, and terminates the remote connection.

methods.name: OCIContainer::Information
methods.description: Returns a JSON string with the service name.
